title: Apache ORC signature
summary: An ORC file ends with the 3-byte magic 'ORC' (0x4F 0x52 0x43) in the postscript.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Magic 'ORC' (0x4F 0x52 0x43) at the very end of the file.
ORC is a columnar storage format for Hadoop/Spark.
ORC supports predicate pushdown and built-in indexes.
